Same overall gate/return line, same fix location; the dispatch's specific sub-condition attribution was imprecise. Per DEV_PROCESS 3.2, reporting this is a successful outcome, not a contradiction of the mission.

investigation.requiredFieldsTension: AuthoritativeSetbackResolution.district is a DistrictMappingResult wrapping a SetbackDistrict, which types max_height_ft/max_lot_coverage_pct/max_impervious_pct/citation_url as required (non-optional) numbers/string. The atom wire shape (AtomChainSetbackWire) carries none of these -- only front/side/rear/side_corner. Do-not-invent forbids fabricating a real height/coverage/impervious number. Resolution: verified the codebase ALREADY has a real, working convention for this -- bastrop-development-code.json's own SF-1..RR rows set max_lot_coverage_pct: 0 paired with provenance.max_lot_coverage_pct.not_specified: true (confirmed by reading the live JSON), and derive.ts's fieldNotSpecified() already reads that provenance flag for side_corner_ft/front_ft/side_ft/rear_ft (not yet for the three bulk-standard fields -- see CP2 finding). Design: districtFromAtomOnly() sets height/coverage/impervious to 0 with not_specified:true provenance and citation_url to "" (empty, not fabricated), following this existing convention rather than inventing one.
